defects.kind: Russian anatomical term/scope in two distractor notes
defects.finding: The source describes fibrous and cartilaginous joints in the broad English sense of articulation (9.1 L34–38). CURRENT translates these as «в некоторых суставах» and «в хрящевом суставе». In Russian anatomical usage сустав denotes the movable/discontinuous articulation; the cited English category explicitly includes immobile skull sutures atL40 and immobile/slightly mobile cartilage articulations atL38. These notes therefore carry the same unqualified scope transfer independently visible in their own literal text. The limited «в некоторых» in note2 does not establish a new source claim about fibrous tissue within a narrower synovial joint.
